title: How to Build a Dyson Sphere - The Ultimate Megastructure
summary: A Kurzgesagt animated explainer on how humanity could build a Dyson sphere, a swarm of structures capturing the sun's energy. It covers using Mercury's materials and a step-by-step construction approach.
why: HN links it as a nice intro to what a realistic Dyson swarm would require, and as a companion to megastructure discussions.

quote.text: Nice intro video on what may be realistically required to build a Dyson sphere
